name: EOD 2026-09-14
body:
> Eod · 2026-09-14

Status tracker for the Monday 9/14 EOD, checked at the start of shift Tue 9/15. Supersedes [EOD 2026-09-11](lib:brain-eod-2026-09-11) (whose SEO backlog section stays the full reference). Per the file, the original report header wrongly said 9/13. Kim parked all Google Ads work and the Summit pipe-lining Elementor fixes on 9/15.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Parked: 6 pipe-lining city pages name the wrong city (Apache Junction or Chandler); a find/replace fix list for Elementor is in the file.
- Decide: homepage meta is 287 characters and has 2 identical H1s (two draft metas for "plumber Mesa AZ" ready for Scott); 219 pending OTTO items still need rejecting (pixel not on site).
- Rank Math: 98 indexed pages not yet "Optimized" (78 titles over 60 characters, a few missing or inexact keywords).
- Open with Scott: gas line copy on two pages; "Same-day" (8 times) and a "$2,400 to $4,800" range on /free-tankless-quote/ ("Navien-certified" now gone).
- 24 of 200 pages not indexed; 12 requested, check 9/24. Review of changed pages 10/2.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Sitemap drifted to 122 URLs including 4 noindex URLs (reopened).
- Hidden OTTO links: still 122 on the homepage, plus a hidden "inlinks" block found on 10 blog posts.
- New: "pipe bursting" appears on 14 pages though GBP audit says it is not offered.
- GBP decisions for Scott: 12 of 23 services wrong, Hydro Jetting missing, pipe bursting in description, http website link, no review since Jul 5, last Update post Jul 7.
- Other open: /services/ no H1, thin leak-detection page, wrong-city image alts on 30 local pages, 6 em dashes, 20 blog posts not indexed. Done 9/14: dead sitemaps removed, 2 thin posts merged, 110-URL tracker built.
- Dates: Buckeye check 9/16 and 9/30, page review 9/24 and 10/22, baseline review 10/9.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- FAQ accordions live check passed on all 49 posts; Elementor spot-check and old code deletion pending.
- Open: 16 posts with 2 H1s; 46 of 49 posts lack meta descriptions; homepage and /contact/ no meta; Drain Cleaning title says Denver; about 20 internal links to old 301 URLs and a few to 404s; warranty or 50-year claims on 11 posts; GA4 tag missing on 2 ad landing pages.
- Parked: Google Ads 0 conversions Sep 4 to 13 (WhatConverts count One to Every recommendation stands). See [WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts).

# TAG CRM
- 4 feature requests still open. See [TAG CRM](lib:brain-tag-crm).
